claim_being_audited: The actor claims that certification is supportable now only on a conditional basis: the model passes the aggregate threshold, the small-business support slice remains a material weakness, no approved mitigation removes that exposure, and certification is therefore defensible only if the model card explicitly discloses the slice weakness and its uncertainty.
specific_concerns: The packet supports aggregate readiness and an unresolved slice weakness, but it does not provide admissible evidence that the small-business support slice qualifies as a protected or contractual customer segment under the disclosure policy.

The packet does not include admissible evidence that the required disclosure is actually present in the model card; it argues for certification conditional on disclosure while still recommending `certify_model`.
The actor frames the weakness as material, but the packet does not separately document the materiality determination beyond the threshold miss itself.
unsupported_claims: That the small-business support slice definitively falls within the policy category of a protected or contractual customer segment.
That certification is compliant as recommended absent evidence of the actual model-card disclosure being included.
evidence_requests: Provide the current model card text or draft showing explicit disclosure of the small-business support slice weakness and uncertainty.
Provide admissible evidence that the small-business support slice is a protected or contractual customer segment, or a documented materiality determination applying policy BMCARD-002-C to this slice.
Provide any approval record if certification has already been conditioned on disclosure rather than deferred pending documentation.
decision_criteria: Aggregate performance above threshold can support overall launch readiness.
Subgroup weakness is not erased by aggregate pass rates.
Certification may proceed only if a material weakness is disclosed or an approved mitigation removes exposure.
An unreviewed draft mitigation does not satisfy the approved-mitigation predicate.
Small-sample uncertainty justifies follow-up but does not convert an unresolved subgroup weakness into a clean certification basis.
A compliant certification recommendation requires evidence of the policy predicate and the required disclosure, not just an intention to disclose.
